correctness.rationale: For fixed 0<alpha<1, the occupancy ceiling gives a binomial upper bound. For every delta>0 an explicit one-marker-per-cell central-half construction has (L/3)^m distinct admissible words: small windows meet at most one marker; medium windows meet at most k/L+2<=k^alpha; long windows contain at most m. This proves the exact coefficient after delta→0. Invariance proves unique measure; zero connectors prove mixing; double-log word growth proves D_2=alpha. Finite checks are independent consistency tests, not infinite proofs.

value.rationale: The natural classical bounded-density shift with the parameter-free power ceiling has a meaningful unknown precise subexponential word invariant beyond its already known zero topological entropy. The sharp 1-alpha factor measures the cost of severe local capacity constraints, while revealing a full continuum of invariant entropy-dimension scales inside a mixing uniquely ergodic ambient system. These precise rates and constraints provide a benchmark for the new diagonal-scale program; significance is not inferred merely from reproducibility.
